meaning:
πόνος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for עָמָל, etc. ;]
1. labour, toil: Col.4:13
2. The consequence of toil, distress, suffering, pain (Xen., al., LXX): Rev.16:10-11 21:4.†
SYN.: see: κόπος (AS)

elsewhere.note: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.
